fields.value: Mid-infrared transient found by Oddsky (oddsky.ai) in archival WISE/NEOWISE data, by difference imaging of the unWISE time-resolved coadds (NEO11 version, courtesy A. Meisner; Meisner, Lang & Schlegel 2018), and measured in public Spitzer/IRAC images from IRSA (SPIRITS programmes 13053 and 14089, PI M. Kasliwal). The discovery point is the earliest >= 5 sigma detection: IRAC [3.6] = 20.09 +- 0.10 AB (+33 +- 3 uJy) on 2018-06-02, against the median of 12 flat 2013-2016 epochs; [3.6] was +17 +- 4 uJy (3.9 sigma) on 2017-10-03. Later IRAC: [4.5] = 19.65 +- 0.11 AB on 2018-11-23; [3.6] = 18.13 +- 0.02 AB on 2019-07-02. WISE (difference flux, AB): flat in 11 epochs from 2010 to 2017-07; first >= 5 sigma on 2019-01-27 at W1 = 18.97 +- 0.10, W2 = 18.80 +- 0.22; peak on 2022-07-07 at W1 = 16.52 +- 0.02, W2 = 16.71 +- 0.04; fading to W1 = 18.20 +- 0.09 by 2024-07-06, the last NEOWISE epoch; flux-scale systematic about 0.1 mag. The position is the IRAC centroid of the brightening, 0.8" from the WISE centroid and 0.2" from a 4.5 um source of 41 uJy with no 3.6 um detection in the cryogenic-era Spitzer SEIP catalogue (SSTSL2 J130552.71-492458.3). No Gaia DR3 source within 6". ATLAS forced photometry shows no optical counterpart at the infrared peak (3-sigma limits c > 22.0, o > 21.0 AB). 309" NE of the centre of NGC 4945. No spectrum.
Spitzer Space Telescope (NASA/JPL-Caltech); SPIRITS, PI M. Kasliwal; data from IRSA

Instrument=Spitzer/IRAC (warm mission), [3.6], SPIRITS programme 13053 (PI M. Kasliwal), AOR 60808704; 9 BCD frames at the source, 2017-10-03 09:02 to 09:15 UT; public post-BCD mosaic from IRSA; difference-aperture photometry (2.4" radius, aperture-corrected) at the reported position against the median of 12 flat 2013-2016 epochs (leave-one-out). Measured +17.2 +- 4.4 uJy (3.9 sigma, below the 5-sigma threshold; the rise may already have begun). Limit is 5 sigma, AB. Same AOR [4.5]: +7.8 +- 4.6 uJy (1.7 sigma), 5-sigma limit 20.50 AB.
Spitzer Space Telescope (NASA/JPL-Caltech); SPIRITS, PI M. Kasliwal; data from IRSA

Instrument=Spitzer/IRAC (warm mission), [3.6], SPIRITS programme 13053 (PI M. Kasliwal), AOR 60808960; 7 BCD frames at the source, 2018-06-02 05:04 to 05:16 UT ([4.5] did not cover the position in this AOR); public post-BCD mosaic from IRSA; difference-aperture photometry (2.4" radius, aperture-corrected) at the reported position against the median of 12 flat 2013-2016 epochs (leave-one-out). Difference flux 33.3 +- 3.1 uJy (10.7 sigma). IRAC calibration/aperture systematic ~10%.

Discovery summary: Spitzer/IRAC (SPIRITS) and unWISE W1/W2 difference light curves 2007-2024 (IRAC discovery 2018-06-02 marked), and WISE W1/W2 difference stamps at the WISE last non-detection, first WISE detection and W1 peak (Oddsky H0012-NGC4945-1).
